text: Dave ate 14. The seagull ate 14 / 2 = 7. The pigeons ate 3 * 3 = 9. The raccoon ate 2 * 14 / 3 = 28 / 3 = 9.67. The ants ate 1. The total eaten is 14 + 7 + 9 + 9.67 + 1 = 31.67. The remaining is 5. So the total was 31.67 + 5 = 36.67. Since the number of fries must be a whole number, we round to the nearest whole number, which is 37. The answer is 37.
Tom gets 4 car washes a month. Each car wash costs $15. So in a year, he gets 4 * 12 = 48 car washes. 48 * 15 = 720. The answer is 720.

Sean's solo song has 54 lines. The first scene has twice the number of lines, so 54 * 2 = 108 lines. A third of these lines are his, so 108 / 3 = 36 lines. The second scene has six more lines than the song, so 54 + 6 = 60 lines. Four-fifths of these lines are his, so 60 * 4/5 = 48 lines. The total number of lines Sean has to memorize is 36 + 48 = 84. The answer is 84.
Let's denote the number of copies Harald sold as x. Then Marilyn sold 10x copies. Together, they sold x + 10x = 11x copies. We know that 11x = 88,000. So x = 88,000 / 11 = 8,000. The answer is 8,000.
The sum of their ages is 20. In 10 years, their ages will be 20 + 10 = 30. The answer is 30.
Grace weighs 125 pounds. Alex weighs 2 pounds less than 4 times what Grace weighs. So Alex weighs 4 * 125 - 2 = 498 pounds. Their combined weights are 125 + 498 = 623 pounds. The answer is 623.
Let's denote the total land as x. 3/5 of x is sold, so 2/5 of x is left. 2/5 * x = 12.8. x = 12.8 * 5 / 2 = 32. The answer is 32.

There are 60 letters needing stamps. One-third of 60 is 60 / 3 = 20. So 20 letters were stamped. There are 30 letters already stamped. So there were 30 - 20 = 10 letters in the pile of already-stamped letters when Jennie began. The answer is 10.
Raymond was born 6 years before Samantha. So Raymond was born at the age of 31 - 6 = 25. Raymond had a son at the age of 23. So the son was born 25 - 23 = 2 years ago. The answer is 2.

John has 10 hectares of a pineapple field. There are 100 pineapples per hectare. So in total, John has 10 * 100 = 1000 pineapples. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months. So in a year, he can harvest 12 / 3 = 4 times. So in total, he can harvest 1000 * 4 = 4000 pineapples. The answer is 4000.

The top level has a square footage of 16. The second level has a square footage of 16 / 2 = 8. The third level has a square footage of 8 / 2 = 4. The fourth level has a square footage of 4 / 2 = 2. The average square footage is (16 + 8 + 4 + 2) / 4 = 30 / 4 = 7.5. The answer is 7.5.

Mike plays ping pong for 40 minutes. In the first 20 minutes, he scores 4 points. In the second 20 minutes, he scores 25% more points. 25% of 4 is 1. So he scores 4 + 1 = 5 points in the second 20 minutes. The total points he scored is 4 + 5 = 9. The answer is 9.
The cost of 2 shirts is 2 * $30 = $60. The discount is 40% of $60, which is 0.4 * $60 = $24. The price after the discount is $60 - $24 = $36. The answer is $36.
There are 3 rows of 8 stars. 3 * 8 = 24. There are 2 rows of 6 stars. 2 * 6 = 12. 76 - 24 - 12 = 40. 40 / 5 = 8. The answer is 8.
Isabelle spent $12 + $43 + $15 + $4 + $22 = $96. She split the cost evenly three ways with her two parents. So each person paid $96 / 3 = $32. The answer is $32.

In the first month, the program had 60 downloads. In the second month, the number of downloads was three times as many as the downloads in the first month, which is 3 * 60 = 180. Then, the number of downloads reduced by 30% in the third month. 30% of 180 is 0.3 * 180 = 54. So, the number of downloads in the third month is 180 - 54 = 126. The total number of downloads over the three months is 60 + 180 + 126 = 366. The answer is 366.
The desk starts at $200. Then it goes up $50 each time. So the total amount is $200 + $50 + $50 + $50 = $350. The answer is $350.

There were 2 containers of imported vehicles, each having 5 vehicles inside. So there were 2 * 5 = 10 vehicles. The next day, more containers were brought in, and the total number of vehicles at the port became 30. So there were 30 - 10 = 20 more vehicles. Since each container contains 5 vehicles, there were 20 / 5 = 4 containers. The answer is 4.

Kelly has 5 quarters and 2 dimes. 5 quarters = 5 * 25 = 125 cents. 2 dimes = 2 * 10 = 20 cents. Total = 125 + 20 = 145 cents. She buys a can of pop for 55 cents. 145 - 55 = 90 cents. The answer is 90 cents.
The city is 42 miles across. The fog bank covers 3 miles in 10 minutes. So it will take 42 / 3 = 14 * 10 = 140 minutes to cover the whole city. The answer is 140.

The initial amount for the first half of the year is $140. The other half of the year is 10% less than $140, which is $140 - ($140 * 0.10) = $140 - $14 = $126. The total amount Aleena paid is $140 + $126 = $266. The answer is $266.
Each topaz gemstone is 1 inch long. Each sterling silver bead is 1/4 inch long. Each necklace is 25 inches long. 25 - 8 = 17. 17 / 0.25 = 68. The answer is 68.
John drinks 3 glasses of water each day. 3 glasses/day * 5 days/week = 15 glasses/week. The answer is 15.

Candice had 80 post-it notes. She placed a single Post-it note on each of 220 different cups of coffee. So she used 220 Post-it notes. 80 - 220 = -140. She had -140 Post-it notes. She purchased a package of Post-it notes. She had 23 Post-it notes remaining. So she had 23 - (-140) = 23 + 140 = 163. The answer is 163.
The doll cost as much as 3 action figures. 3 action figures cost 3 * $5 = $15. The doll cost $15. The red car cost $4. So all toys cost $15 + $4 = $19. The answer is $19.
The inner volume of one box is (5-2) * (6-2) * (4-2) = 3 * 4 * 2 = 24. The total inner volume of all 3 boxes is 24 * 3 = 72. The answer is 72.

Axel has 50 silver pesos and 80 gold pesos. Anna has twice as many silver pesos as Axel, which is 2 * 50 = 100 silver pesos. Anna has 40 more gold pesos than Axel, which is 80 + 40 = 120 gold pesos. Together, they have 50 + 80 + 100 + 120 = 350 pesos. The answer is 350.
Chris has 6 trees. Ferdinand has 6 / 2 = 3 trees. Harry has 2 * 3 + 5 = 11 trees. The difference is 11 - 3 = 8. The answer is 8.

Melanie sold a third of her vacuum cleaners at the green house. So she sold 1/3 of her vacuum cleaners. Then she sold 2 more to the red house. Then she sold half of what was left at the orange house. So she sold 1/2 of the remaining vacuum cleaners. If she has 5 vacuum cleaners left, then she must have started with 5 + 2 + 1/2 * (1/3 * x) = 5, where x is the number of vacuum cleaners she started with. Solving for x, we get x = 15. The answer is 15.

Eliza's rate per hour for the first 40 hours she works each week is $10. She also receives an overtime pay of 1.2 times her regular hourly rate. If Eliza worked for 45 hours this week, her earnings for this week are $10 * 40 + $10 * 1.2 * 5 = $400 + $60 = $460. The answer is $460.

Theo has $6000. He buys 6 business suits at $100 each, so 6 * $100 = $600. He buys 3 suitcases at $50 each, so 3 * $50 = $150. The flight ticket costs $700 more than 5 times as much as the cost of a business suit. 5 * $100 = $500, so $500 + $700 = $1200. The total cost is $600 + $150 + $1200 = $1950. He wishes to save $2000, so $6000 - $2000 = $4000. The answer is $4000.

There are 60 dogs. There are 2 cats for every dog. So there are 2 * 60 = 120 cats. The number of rabbits is 12 less than the combined number of dogs and cats. So there are 60 + 120 - 12 = 168 rabbits. The total number of pets is 60 + 120 + 168 = 348. The answer is 348.

Initially, Elaine had 20 Pokemon cards. After a month, she collected three times that number, which is 3 * 20 = 60. In the second month, she collected 20 fewer cards than those she collected in the first month, which is 60 - 20 = 40. In the third month, she collected twice the combined number of Pokemon cards she collected in the first and second months, which is 2 * (60 + 40) = 2 * 100 = 200. The total number of Pokemon cards she has now is 20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320. The answer is 320.
Annika brought $50 to the town fair. She spent half of it on food and snacks. So she spent $50 / 2 = $25. She spent an additional $10 for rides. $25 + $10 = $35. $50 - $35 = $15. The answer is $15.

Each pepper costs 15$. A watermelon costs 3 times what each pepper costs. So a watermelon costs 3 * 15 = 45$. An orange costs 5 less than what a watermelon costs. So an orange costs 45 - 5 = 40$. Dillon is sent to the store to buy 4 watermelons, 20 peppers, and 10 oranges. The total amount of money he will spend is 4 * 45 + 20 * 15 + 10 * 40 = 180 + 300 + 400 = 880. The answer is 880.

Dean's mother gave him $28. He bought 6 toy cars and 5 teddy bears. Each toy car cost $2 and each teddy bear cost $1. So he spent 6 * 2 + 5 * 1 = 12 + 5 = 17. After his mother gave him an extra $10, he had 28 + 10 - 17 = 21. The answer is 21.
There are 6 rows and 6 columns. So there are 6 * 6 = 36 books. Double the number of books is 2 * 36 = 72. 20 more than double the number of books is 72 + 20 = 92. The answer is 92.
Mrs. Sherman made 12 rolls. She fed 6 children with one each. So she had 12 - 6 = 6 rolls left. She broke each of the remaining rolls into 8 pieces. So she had 6 * 8 = 48 pieces. The answer is 48.
The winner got 3/4 of the votes. So the loser got 1/4 of the votes. 1/4 of 80 is 80 * 1/4 = 20. The answer is 20.

Debra saw 30 bees leave the hive in the first 6 hours. Then she saw 1/2 that many bees return in the next 6 hours. 1/2 * 30 = 15. So she saw 15 bees return. Then she saw two times as many bees as she saw first leave the hive fly from the hive and leave in the next 6 hours. 2 * 30 = 60. So she saw 60 bees leave. Then every bee that left before that hadn't already returned returned to the hive in the next 6 hours. 30 - 15 = 15. So 15 bees returned. The answer is 15.

44 seniors need to receive awards.  Each senior receives a picture frame that costs $20.  Each picture frame needs to be etched with the logo for an additional 20% cost per frame. 2 of the seniors will also receive pins that are $5. 1/4 of the seniors are officers and they will need to receive cords that are $12 each.  The cost of the picture frames is 44 * $20 = $880. The cost of the etched picture frames is 44 * $20 * 20% = $176. The cost of the pins is 2 * $5 = $10. The cost of the cords is 11 * $12 = $132. The total cost is $880 + $176 + $10 + $132 = $1198. The answer is $1198.
There were originally 30 cars. 5 cars took an exit. So there were 30 - 5 = 25 cars left. 20 more cars drove through. So 25 - 20 = 5. The answer is 5.

There are 4 snails in one aquarium and 32 snails in another aquarium. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is 32 - 4 = 28. This is twice the amount of fish in both aquariums. So there are 28 / 2 = 14 fish in each aquarium. The answer is 14.
There are 50 socks that need washing. She washes 10 pairs of socks. 10 pairs of socks is 10 * 2 = 20. She also washes 15 loose socks. 20 + 15 = 35. 50 - 35 = 15. The answer is 15.

Jill gets paid $20 per hour to teach and $30 to be a cheerleading coach. She works 50 weeks a year, 35 hours a week as a teacher and 15 hours a week as a coach. So her annual salary is (50 * 35 * 20) + (50 * 15 * 30) = 35000 + 22500 = 57500. The answer is 57500.
Johnny had $20. He added $10. So he had $20 + $10 = $30. After a year, the money tripled. So he had $30 * 3 = $90. The answer is $90.

Tommy sells 43 brownies for $3 each. So he makes 43 * 3 = $129. Tommy sells 23 slices of cheesecake for $4 each. So he makes 23 * 4 = $92. The total amount of money Tommy raises is $129 + $92 = $221. The answer is $221.

Let's denote Lylah's salary as x. Adrien's salary was 30% higher than Lylah's, so Adrien's salary was 1.3x. Four years later, Adrien's salary had increased by 40%, so his new salary was 1.4 * 1.3x = 1.82x. Since Adrien's salary increased simultaneously, Lylah's salary also increased by 40%, so her new salary was 1.4x. The total salary the two were receiving four years later is 1.82x + 1.4x = 3.22x. We know that Adrien's salary four years ago was $40000, which is 1.3x = 40000. Solving for x, we get x = 40000 / 1.3 = 30769.23. The total salary the two were receiving four years later is 3.22 * 30769.23 = 99333.33. The answer is $99333.33.

Steve lives 3 miles from the school. He can bike at 440 feet per minute. So it will take Steve 3 * 5280 / 440 = 36 minutes to get home. Tim lives 2 miles from the school. He can ride his skateboard at 264 feet per minute. So it will take Tim 2 * 5280 / 264 = 40 minutes to get home. The winner will be waiting 40 - 36 = 4 minutes. The answer is 4.

There are 2 houses. Each house has 3 bedrooms. Each bedroom has 2 windows. So there are 2 * 3 * 2 = 12 windows in the bedrooms. There are 2 houses. Each house has 4 windows not connected to bedrooms. So there are 2 * 4 = 8 windows not connected to bedrooms. 12 + 8 = 20. The answer is 20.

Jessa is 20 years old. Joan is 5 years older than Jessa, so Joan is 20 + 5 = 25. Mary is 2 years younger than Joan, so Mary is 25 - 2 = 23. The sum of the ages of the three girls is 20 + 25 + 23 = 68. The answer is 68.

Janet had 22 green pens and 10 yellow pens. She bought 6 bags of blue pens and 2 bags of red pens. There were 9 pens in each bag of blue and 6 pens in each bag of red. So she had 6 * 9 = 54 blue pens and 2 * 6 = 12 red pens. In total, she had 22 + 10 + 54 + 12 = 98 pens. The answer is 98.

Let's say they lost x games. Then they won x + 8 games. Since they played 22 games, x + (x + 8) = 22. This simplifies to 2x + 8 = 22. Subtracting 8 from both sides gives 2x = 14. Dividing both sides by 2 gives x = 7. So they lost 7 games and won 7 + 8 = 15 games. The answer is 15.
Jean has 30 lollipops. She eats 2 of the lollipops. 30 - 2 = 28. She wants to package 2 lollipops in one bag. 28 / 2 = 14. The answer is 14.

The ratio of popsicles that Betty and Sam have is 5:6. So the total number of parts is 5 + 6 = 11. The total number of popsicles they have together is 165. So each part is 165 / 11 = 15. Betty has 5 * 15 = 75 popsicles. Sam has 6 * 15 = 90 popsicles. Sam has 90 - 75 = 15 more popsicles than Betty. The answer is 15.

The first bag has 300 M&Ms. The second bag has 12 more M&Ms than the first, so it has 300 + 12 = 312 M&Ms. The third bag has half the number of M&Ms that the first bag had, so it has 300 / 2 = 150 M&Ms. The total number of M&Ms Mary got is 300 + 312 + 150 = 762. The answer is 762.

Henry made two stops during his 60-mile bike trip. He first stopped after 20 miles. His second stop was 15 miles before the end of the trip. So he traveled 20 + 15 = 35 miles between his first and second stops. The answer is 35.

The first box had 500 pieces. The second box had 3 times more pieces than the first box, so it had 3 * 500 = 1500 pieces. The third box had 1/4 the number of pieces as the first box, so it had 500 / 4 = 125 pieces. In total, Johnny picks up 500 + 1500 + 125 = 2125 pieces. The answer is 2125.
There are 12 inches in a foot. So 4 feet is 4 * 12 = 48 inches. 48 / 6 = 8. The answer is 8.

Morisette brought 5 apples and 8 oranges. Kael brought twice the amount of apples and half the number of oranges than Morisette. So Kael brought 2 * 5 = 10 apples and 8 / 2 = 4 oranges. In total, they have 5 + 8 + 10 + 4 = 27. The answer is 27.

James has 30 fire type, 20 grass type, and 40 water type. So in total he has 30 + 20 + 40 = 90 cards. After losing 8 of the water type, he has 40 - 8 = 32 water type cards. After buying 14 grass type, he has 20 + 14 = 34 grass type cards. So the total number of cards he has now is 30 + 34 + 32 = 96. The percentage chance that a randomly picked card will be a water type is (32/96) * 100 = 33.33%. The answer is 33.

On Tuesdays, she had 1 hour of practice. On Thursdays, she had 2 hours of practice. On Saturdays, she had 2 * 1 = 2 hours of practice. So in total, she had 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 hours of practice. The answer is 5.

The ratio of sugar to water is 7:13. The total number of parts is 7 + 13 = 20. The number of parts that sugar represents is 7/20. The number of parts that sugar represents is 120 * (7/20) = 42. The answer is 42.
Bailey starts with a certain amount of money. Then she receives a weekly allowance of $5 for 8 weeks. At the end of the 8 weeks, if she has a total of $100, how much money did Bailey start with?

Each person consumes 0.2 kg of rice every meal. So in total, they consume 0.2 * 2 = 0.4 kg of rice per day. For 5 people, they consume 0.4 * 5 = 2 kg of rice per day. A 42 kg bag of rice will last 42 / 2 = 21 days. Since there are 7 days in a week, the bag will last 21 / 7 = 3 weeks. The answer is 3.

Luke ate 2 hot dogs. Thomas ate three times more hot dogs than Luke. So Thomas ate 2 * 3 = 6 hot dogs. John ate half the amount Thomas ate. So John ate 6 / 2 = 3 hot dogs. John ate 3 - 2 = 1 more hot dog than Luke. The answer is 1.
There are 16 balls. Half of the balls are golf balls, so there are 16 / 2 = 8 golf balls. Half of the golf balls are blue, so there are 8 / 2 = 4 blue golf balls. The answer is 4.
On Monday, Kylie collected 20 + 5 = 25 shells. On Tuesday, she collected 2 * 25 = 50 shells. The answer is 50.

Griffin had 24 french fries. Kyle took 5 of them. Billy took twice as many as Kyle, which is 2 * 5 = 10. So, Griffin had 24 - 5 - 10 = 9 fries left. Ginger gave Griffin a handful of her fries, and then Colby took 3 less than the number of fries that Kyle had taken, which is 5 - 3 = 2. So, in the end, Griffin had 9 + x - 2 = 27, where x is the number of fries Ginger gave him. Solving for x, we get x = 27 - 9 + 2 = 20. The answer is 20.

The Doubtfire sisters are driving home with 7 kittens adopted from the local animal shelter. Their mother calls to inform them that their two house cats have just had kittens. She says that Patchy, the first cat, has had thrice the number of adopted kittens, while Trixie, the other cat, has had 12. So, Patchy has had 3 * 7 = 21 kittens, and Trixie has had 12 kittens. In total, the Doubtfire family now has 7 + 21 + 12 = 40 kittens. The answer is 40.

Mary has 30 sheep. Half of them is 30 / 2 = 15. She gets 1 kg of milk from 15 sheep and 2 kg of milk from the other 15 sheep. So she gets 15 * 1 + 15 * 2 = 15 + 30 = 45 kg of milk every day. The answer is 45.

Lloyd earns $10 an hour. He tutored 5 hours for the first week. So he earned 5 * 10 = $50. He tutored 8 hours for the second week. So he earned 8 * 10 = $80. In total, he earned $50 + $80 = $130. The answer is $130.
The first train traveled 80 miles. The second train traveled 150 miles. So in total, they traveled 80 + 150 = 230 miles. The answer is 230.

Mike was a pen pal with 5 people.  He stopped being penpals with 2 of them.  So he is still a pen pal with 5 - 2 = 3 people.  They each send 2 letters a week that are 5 pages long.  So in total, they send 2 * 5 = 10 pages a week.  Mike responds in kind.  So he writes 10 pages a week.  He can write a page every 6 minutes.  So he spends 10 * 6 = 60 minutes a week writing.  There are 60 minutes in an hour.  So he spends 60 / 60 = 1 hour a week writing. The answer is 1.

Each can of tomatoes contains 3 tomatoes. Freda’s last batch of tomato sauce made 32 ounces of sauce. Since the volume of the sauce is half the volume of the can, the can must have been 32 * 2 = 64 ounces. Each can contains 3 tomatoes, so 64 / 3 = 21.33. Since Freda can't use a fraction of a tomato, she must have used 21 tomatoes. The answer is 21.

The bridge can carry 5000 pounds. The driver and the empty truck weigh 3755 pounds. So the remaining weight is 5000 - 3755 = 1245 pounds. Each box weighs 15 pounds. So the maximum number of boxes is 1245 / 15 = 83. The answer is 83.

The gas station is selling gas for $3.00 a gallon. The app company is offering $.20 cashback per gallon if you fill up at this station. If someone buys 10 gallons of gas, the total cost would be 10 * $3.00 = $30.00. The cashback rewards would be 10 * $.20 = $2.00. So the total cost after the cashback rewards would be $30.00 - $2.00 = $28.00. The answer is $28.00.

Marcell's roll-ups were 3 wide and 14 long. So he had 3 * 14 = 42. Beatrice's roll-ups were 2 wide and 24 long. So she had 2 * 24 = 48. Together they had 42 + 48 = 90. The average is 90 / 2 = 45. The answer is 45.

Josh bought a house for $80,000. He put in $50,000 in repairs. This increased the value of the house by 150%. So the value of the house after repairs is $80,000 + $50,000 = $130,000. The profit is $130,000 - $80,000 = $50,000. The answer is $50,000.
Nancy owes $0.50 for each of 8 books. So she owes 8 * $0.50 = $4.00. She also owes a flat $2.00 fee. So in total, she owes $4.00 + $2.00 = $6.00. The answer is $6.00.

Six years ago, Noah was half as old as Cera. Cera is currently 46 years old. So, six years ago, Cera was 46 - 6 = 40 years old. Noah was half as old as Cera, so Noah was 40 / 2 = 20 years old. The population of Chile six years ago was 3000 times the age of Noah, so the population was 3000 * 20 = 60000. The population of Chile now is 60000 * 2 = 120000. The answer is 120000.

Jerome's first friend pressed on the doorbell 20 times. The second friend pressed on the doorbell 1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend. So the second friend pressed on the doorbell 20 + (1/4 * 20) = 20 + 5 = 25 times. The third friend pressed on the doorbell 10 times more than the fourth friend. The fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times. So the third friend pressed on the doorbell 60 + 10 = 70 times. The fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times. The total number of doorbell rings is 20 + 25 + 70 + 60 = 175. The answer is 175.

There are 105 members in total. There are twice as many players on the offense as there is on the defense. There is half the number of players on the special teams as there is on the defense. Let's denote the number of players on the defense as x. Then the number of players on the offense is 2x, and the number of players on the special teams is x/2. We have the equation: x + 2x + x/2 = 105. Combining like terms, we get 3.5x = 105. Dividing both sides by 3.5, we get x = 30. The answer is 30.
Sally Four is 8 years old. Granny Red is 2 * 8 = 16 years old. Sally Two is 16 + 3 = 19 years old. The total age of the four birds is 8 + 16 + 19 + 8 = 51. The answer is 51.

Jamal's phone can hold 1800 photographs. Brittany's phone can hold 1/6 of that, which is 1800 / 6 = 300. Brittany's phone can hold 50 times more photographs than the number of birds in Jamal's photograph. So the number of birds in Jamal's photograph is 300 / 50 = 6. The answer is 6.

There are 4 teachers. Each teacher has 2 lessons per day. So in total, there are 4 * 2 = 8 lessons per day. The whiteboard is cleaned 3 times per lesson. So the whiteboard is cleaned 8 * 3 = 24 times per day. The answer is 24.

The coffee is cooled by 65 degrees. Each ice cube cools the coffee by 13 degrees. So, 65 / 13 = 5. The coffee is 5 times weaker. The coffee is also 12 milliliters weaker. So, 5 * 12 = 60. The coffee is 60 milliliters weaker. The answer is 60.

Carlos rents a canoe for $30 an hour. He uses it for 3 hours. So he pays 30 * 3 = 90. Benji rents a banana boat raft for $18 an hour. He uses it for 5 hours. So he pays 18 * 5 = 90. Together they pay 90 + 90 = 180. The answer is 180.

Annabelle has $80 in her savings. She earns $10 per hour at her first job and works 20 hours. She earns $5 per hour at her second job and works 15 hours. So she earns $10 * 20 = $200 at her first job and $5 * 15 = $75 at her second job. In total, she earns $200 + $75 = $275. She needs $400 - $275 = $125 more to buy the phone. The answer is $125.

Baldur gets 5 pails of water every morning and 6 pails of water every afternoon. So he gets 5 + 6 = 11 pails of water every day. Each pail contains 5 liters of water. So he gets 11 * 5 = 55 liters of water every day. The answer is 55.
John collects 2 peaches a minute. He does this for 3 hours. 3 hours is 3 * 60 = 180 minutes. So he collects 2 * 180 = 360 peaches. The answer is 360.

Vincent can buy 18 flowers in packages of 3 for 18 / 3 = 6 packages. The cost is 6 * $2.50 = $15. Alternatively, he can buy 18 flowers in packages of 2 for 18 / 2 = 9 packages. The cost is 9 * $1 = $9. The difference is $15 - $9 = $6. The answer is $6.

Mitchel went down the water slide 30 times. Anne went down the slide 30% less than Mitchel. 30% of 30 is 9. So Anne went down the slide 30 - 9 = 21 times. Robert went down the slide 4 times as much as Anne. 4 * 21 = 84. The answer is 84.

Mark has $50 in his bank account. He earns $10 per day. To buy a bike that costs $300, he needs to save $300 - $50 = $250. Since he earns $10 per day, he needs to save for 250 / 10 = 25 days. The answer is 25.
The probability of rolling a number greater than 3 is 3/6 = 1/2. The probability of rolling two even numbers in a row is 3/6 * 3/6 = 1/4. The difference is 1/2 - 1/4 = 1/4. The answer is 25%.

The pink frog weighs 50 pounds. The blue beetle weighs 50 pounds. The green toad weighs 60 pounds. The yellow snake weighs 70 pounds. The red bird weighs 30 pounds. The total weight is 50 + 50 + 60 + 70 + 30 + 20 = 280. The answer is 280.

Zaid spends 1/4 of his salary on rent, 1/3 on car fuel and donates half of the remaining amount to his favorite charity. He gives his daughter 200$ to use for her weekly expenses and 700$ to his wife to budget for groceries and other household goods. If Zaid earns 6000$ per month, how much money will he still have after all these expenses and donations?
John has 13 lego sets. He sells them for $15 each. So he has 13 * 15 = 195. He buys 8 video games for $20 each. So he has 8 * 20 = 160. He has 195 - 160 = 35 left. The answer is 35.
